item.title: BOOST VECTOR EX
item.description:
Title: BOOST VECTOR EX
Genre: Action , Indie , Racing , Sports
Developer: Blockage
Publisher: Blockage
Release Date: Nov 2, 2026




About This Game

BOOST VECTOR EX is stylish high-speed parkour racing at its finest. With speeds unapologetically fast.

Race unique, fully handcrafted maps.

Race vertical beaches, down the sides of megalithic skyscrapers, or unreal dreamscapes that are totally not existential in nature!

Each one made with a great deal of care, no two maps are alike.

Easy to learn. Full of depth. Fully dynamic.

Control the VECTOR MASTERS, each one unique and vastly different from one another. Utilizing their own BOOST and STYLE that gives them an edge on the circuit, completely changing their movement in all aspects.

Perform moves such as: Sliding into a charge jump into a side-strafe into a wall-ride, do a couple tricks, and then boost your way on out. There are many ways to tackle a circuit in unique ways. Let nothing stop your momentum.

Just Boost.

It's in your soul. And... It's in the name. (duh)

This is a dedicated section in the description just for this. That's how important it is!

Talk with the Masters and grow your bonds!

A full-on, fully fleshed out narrative-based story that takes place in an distant land of Walls... Learn about the various aspect of Vector Racing as it debuts as a sport! Get to know the Masters that hone their craft. From legendary tuners, to street-racing legends. The art of Vector Racing is a unforgiving one.

Play with friends, random people, or your rivals...

Take on lobbies of the best racers imaginable! Chances are they'll do some dastardly shortcuts no one dare attempt otherwise.

Other features include:

Full Mod Support!

Global Leaderboards and Records!

Big lore dumps related to our other game, neonKnights!

Taxes!

A Wordle-Clone amply named 'Blockle'

'Horse' Racing?

…And so much more!

Run fast. Faster than any other.

item.title: GRAVHOUNDS
item.description:
Title: GRAVHOUNDS
Genre: Action , Indie , Strategy , Early Access
Developer: Octopus Panic, Inc.
Publisher: Octopus Panic, Inc.
Release Date: Nov 2, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Nov 2, 2026




About This Game

GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

Intense alone, chaotic with a crew. Combine each Gravhound's strengths and improvise to beat back the swarm. Go lone wolf to expand the operation or stick with the pack and stand your ground.

Fetch!

Fling objects across the battlefield to your teammates. Turn gravity against the swarm and send them flying, one by one.

Disclaimer: Transporting volatile materials with the Grav Beam may result in unforeseen loss of Gravhounds.

  • Deploy turrets, generators, and fabricators to expand the operation and defend it from the swarm.

  • Extend pipelines across hostile terrain to power your base, move resources, and keep your escape route alive.

Choose from a crew of bio-engineered canine workers built for dangerous planetary operations.

Loyal.

Obedient.

Expendable.

Unlock powerful new abilities and upgrades mid-shift. Stack bonuses and reshape your loadout to suit the situation. The swarm grows deadlier by the second - but so do you.

Boost in any direction and reposition under fire. Race to your teammates' aid or make a last dash for materials.

Warning: Unauthorized recreational use of pipeline boost is strictly prohibited.

  • Seek out treacherous planets for the best materials - the higher the risk, the greater the rewards.

  • Unlock new Gravhounds, weapons, and upgrade paths.

  • Stay longer, push harder, and the swarm escalates. Every shift becomes a bet on how much your pack can handle.

Far from home.

Swarm closing in.

Still expected to hit quota.

Get to work.

item.title: PlinkIdle
item.description:
Title: PlinkIdle
Genre: Casual , Indie , Strategy
Developer: Black Heart Games LLC
Publisher: Gamersky Games , brokenworm
Release Date: Nov 2, 2026




About This Game

It begins with a single drop. Then another. And another. Before long, you're deep in ever-expanding, ever growing chaos, in a deluge of balls, coins, upgrades, buffs, multipliers, and more.

As the ball-o-meters fill, new stages are unlock with scenic pixel art backdrops to set the mood. Collect every cozy, moody theme as you advance through the game.

Fine tune the audio in settings to get the ASMR juuuuuust right. This game is a rain machine, with an atmospheric chiptunes soundtrack to help set the mood.

As the game progresses, you can hone your playstyle with passive or active choices. Rombo the Autobot will do some work for you if you want to step away, or you can invest in combos, GoldCoins, and Disco balls for enhanced multipliers in active play.

Prestige lets you change how you play each run, with continuous rewards as you reach greater milestones. Every rank makes you more powerful, blasting through the early stages and reaching greater heights.

Sit back, hit the "drop" button, and let the chaos begin.

item.title: Mayday: The Survival Island
item.description:
Title: Mayday: The Survival Island
Genre: Adventure , Indie
Developer: Pequi studios
Publisher: indie.io
Release Date: Nov 2, 2026




About This Game

After a mysterious crash, you awaken alone on a remote island—injured, disoriented, and surrounded by untamed wilderness. Mayday: The Survival Island is an open-world survival crafting game where your mission is to build, adapt, and uncover the truth behind your arrival.

Gather resources, craft tools, and shape your own survival strategy. Hunt wild animals, fish the shoreline, grow crops, and build a homestead to sustain yourself. As your base grows stronger, venture across a sprawling archipelago full of secrets waiting to be unearthed.

Survival and Exploration

Explore a hand-crafted world made up of 24 unique islands—each with distinct environments, resources, and challenges. From misty swamps and sun-bleached beaches to ancient cemeteries and forgotten ruins, every biome offers new opportunities and hidden threats. Find treasure, upgrade your tools, and learn how to adapt to each island’s dangers.

Mystery Beneath the Surface

You’re not just surviving—you’re being watched. Strange symbols, magical totems, and fragments of a lost civilization hint at a greater story hidden beneath the waves. The deeper you explore, the more you’ll question why you crashed here… and whether escape is even possible. Every action, from gathering food to defeating powerful guardians, may reveal new pieces of the truth.

Freedom-Driven Progression

There are no forced objectives or linear paths. You decide how and when the story unfolds. Spend hours building your ideal base, raise animals and tend crops, or set out across the islands in search of answers. Every gameplay system—from fishing to farming to combat—is woven into your journey and rewarded with meaningful discoveries.

Build, Customize, and Evolve

Your base is your lifeline—and your legacy. Gather materials to craft tools, construct shelters, and expand your homestead into a thriving hub. Raise animals, set up farms, and unlock new crafting stations that open up advanced survival options. As your island life becomes more stable, you’ll gain access to new areas, new upgrades, and deeper insights into the world around you. Every structure you build brings you one step closer to mastering the island—or escaping it.

🌊 Survival is just the beginning. The island has plans of its own.
